visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a black baseball cap and a dark grey hoodie, speaks directly to the camera with a surprised and wide-eyed expression in a brightly lit indoor room. (2) The scene shifts to an airplane cabin where a flight attendant in a yellow uniform is seen walking down the aisle, handing out yellow paper forms to passengers seated in purple chairs. (3) A close-up shows another young man in a brown checkered shirt holding a yellow paper form and a pen, looking confused; Keigo leans in from the side to talk to him while holding a smartphone. (4) The visuals transition to a mobile screen recording of the 'Visit Japan Web' interface, showing the language selection menu (Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, etc.) and various data entry steps for immigration and customs. (5) A digital blue checkmark appears over a white box on the screen, followed by the generation of a QR code on the phone screen. (6) The original man (Keigo) is now at an airport terminal, wearing a black face mask and his black cap, proudly holding a red Japanese passport and two boarding passes. (7) The final sequence shows the man in the checkered shirt walking out of the airport arrival gate smoothly, while a graphic overlay emphasizes the ease of the process compared to others using paper forms.
